page.overview:
Who is Candy Baby?

The Candy Baby makes a brief appearance with its mother in the episode "Dream of Love." Candy Baby is surprised when its mother dumps Tree Trunks and Mr. Pig out of its baby carriage. It reappears and talks for the first time in "Hug Wolf," asking its mother why Finn was imprisoned for hugging if hugs were good.

Candy Baby is light green and shaped like candy corn. They are wrapped in white cloth.
